summary: Feed s167_triple to IDS is degraded: 3 faults detected - VLAN tags for required VLANs 10,20 completely missing (100% untagged), 3.5% TCP packet loss, and 70.7% encrypted traffic exceeding 60% tolerance. IDS has full bidirectional visibility but is blind to VLAN context, missing payload for reassembly, and limited by encryption.

findings.root_cause: Upstream SPAN or packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags - 100% of packets are untagged so required VLANs 10 and 20 are never seen. Likely trunk SPAN configured as access or broker set to strip tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot enforce VLAN-aware policies or segment detection for VLANs 10 and 20; misses lateral movement and segmentation violations, reducing detection coverage for those segments.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10,20 through TAP/SPAN and packet broker to IDS so VLAN-aware rules fire correctly.

findings.root_cause: Packet loss in capture path - 59 of 1695 TCP packets (3.48% > 1% threshold) show gaps/retransmissions. With tool_overload healthy, loss is likely SPAN oversubscription or packet broker buffer drops during bursts, not IDS overload.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with needs_full_payload=true cannot reassemble TCP streams reliably; signatures and anomaly detection miss payload, attackers can evade detection via gaps, and alerts become unreliable.

recommended_fix.why: Eliminate SPAN drops by using TAPs and load-balance/hash flows across additional IDS capacity or broker ports to handle bursts without loss.

findings.root_cause: 70.7% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance, indicating most traffic is TLS/encrypted without broker decryption. IDS sees only headers.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to payload for majority of traffic; cannot inspect for exploits, malware, or C2 inside encrypted sessions, significantly reducing detection coverage despite needing full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Add selective TLS decryption at packet broker (or forward to decryption zone) for allowed traffic to bring visible payload below 60% and restore IDS inspection, respecting privacy policy.
